required_features: private relational data path and secure credentials
monitoring, backups, restore tests and bounded scaling
stretch_features: Add a second failure scenario and document recovery evidence.
Automate a repeatable validation check without hard-coding credentials.
Compare one alternative architecture and record measurable trade-offs.
test_plan: Document normal workflow and expected results.
Test denied/invalid inputs or a controlled service-failure scenario.
Record monitoring evidence and recovery procedure.
Check costs and clean up resources in an approved sandbox.
review_method: Human-reviewed design/project with static validation and evidence submitted by the learner. This content package does not provision infrastructure or provide a secure arbitrary-code/cloud runner.
status_note: Project brief adapted from AWS.pdf Section D. Review services, region assumptions, security, current product terminology and estimated costs before publishing.
